scientific_integrity: Proof given analytically with fixed-seed independent numerical cross-checks. Historical priority and independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two exceptional axes, one central Haar-random hyperplane, Euclidean radii; no general codimension result.
The infinite moment conclusion concerns the supercritical distributional limit, not any finite-dimensional radius.
Equivalent low-rank random-matrix formulations may exist beyond the inspected literature.
title: Two-unequal-spike ellipsoid sections: an exact radius law and a heavy-tail transition
